# GENERATED FILE - do not edit. Regenerate with tools/gen_runtime.py
# Eligibility checks only read character skills/balances and set temporary flags.
# Transfer balances are original modifier points; base skills are never changed.

sxad_probe_diplomacy_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = sxad_can_diplomacy value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = sxad_diplomacy_balance }
                var:sxad_diplomacy_balance >= -1000000
                var:sxad_diplomacy_balance < 1000000
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
            scope:sxad_donor = {
                diplomacy > 0
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = sxad_diplomacy_balance }
                    var:sxad_diplomacy_balance > -1000000
                    var:sxad_diplomacy_balance <= 1000000
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            }
        }
        save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = sxad_can_diplomacy value = 1 }
    }
}

# Current character owns the signed balance. Scale is sampled when assigned.
sxad_rebuild_diplomacy_modifier_effect = {
    remove_character_modifier = sxad_diplomacy_gain_modifier
    remove_character_modifier = sxad_diplomacy_loss_modifier
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = sxad_diplomacy_balance }
        if = {
            limit = { var:sxad_diplomacy_balance > 0 }
            add_character_modifier = sxad_diplomacy_gain_modifier
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:sxad_diplomacy_balance < 0 }
            add_character_modifier = sxad_diplomacy_loss_modifier
        }
    }
    force_character_skill_recalculation = yes
}
